title: close.signed-off.v1
description: One message on the Redpanda topic close.signed-off.v1, produced by services/eod-job when a business date's daily close has been signed off: internal reconciliation (Task 7.2), custodian reconciliation (Task 7.3) and the dense snapshot (Task 7.4) have all passed. Keyed by businessDate. Derived from the workflow.close_signoff row (ADR-0021); the row is the system of record. Consumers are idempotent on businessDate -- the event may be re-published if a prior publish was not confirmed. See contracts/events/README.md for the versioning rule.

schemaVersion.description: The event schema version. A consumer that does not recognise this value must route the message to its dead-letter handling, never attempt a best-effort parse. A backwards-incompatible change is a new version (v2) on a new topic, not an edit here.

businessDate.description: The business date whose close was signed off, ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD), from BusinessCalendar. The Redpanda partition key for this topic.

signedOffAt.description: When workflow.close_signoff was written, UTC, microsecond precision (StorableClock).

reconciliationRunId.description: The workflow.reconciliation_run (Task 7.2) that was PASSED for this date when sign-off ran.

custodianRunId.description: The workflow.custodian_reconciliation_run (Task 7.3) that was PASSED for this date when sign-off ran.

snapshotRunId.description: The workflow.snapshot_run (Task 7.4) that was the COMPLETED snapshot of record for this date when sign-off ran.

snapshotObjectKey.description: The object-storage key of the dense snapshot's positions file for this date, e.g. snapshots/dt=2026-08-31/positions.ndjson.gz. Gzipped NDJSON (ADR-0020).

snapshotManifestKey.description: The object-storage key of the dense snapshot's manifest for this date, e.g. snapshots/dt=2026-08-31/manifest.json.

snapshotPositionCount.description: workflow.snapshot_run.position_count for the snapshot of record -- open participant positions on this date. Task 7.5b's statement fan-out must generate exactly this many statements when this date is a month-end; carried here so the scheduler needs no second read.

lastBusinessDayOfMonth.description: Whether businessDate is the last business day of its calendar month, per BusinessCalendar. Task 7.5b's statement scheduler fans out a month's statements only when this is true; every other day's event is still published (for other consumers -- employer reports, tax) but triggers no statement run.
